caption: The drawing depicts a single large tankard or mug seen in profile, oriented with the handle on the left side. The tankard has a wide, slightly tapering cylindrical body with straight lines running vertically upwards from the base to the rim. At the right is a protruding edge forming part of the upper rim. The handle is a large, ornate, backward-curving form attached at both the upper and lower sections of the vessel’s left side, with a decorative scroll at the lower end. A hinged lid with a thumb lever mechanism sits atop the vessel, with the lever extending vertically and ending in a circular knob. The artwork is composed of clean, thin black lines on a plain, light tan or beige background, and includes no shading or color fill within the outline. In the bottom right corner, there is a handwritten signature: "Lawrence Flynn."
title: Silver Tankard
